changes.title: CA/B Forum SC-081: public TLS certificate max validity falls from 398 days to 47 days in steps from March 2026 to March 2029; a hand-renewed one-year certificate will stop being issuable (individual step dates not read)

source.quote: These reductions are proposed to occur starting in March 2026 and concluding in March 2029

changes.title: Exchange Online SMTP AUTH Basic authentication (username/password to smtp.office365.com) disabled by default for existing tenants at end of December 2026; final removal date to be announced in H2 2027; move to OAuth 2.0 or Graph API

source.quote: End of December 2026: SMTP AUTH Basic Authentication will be disabled by default for existing tenants.

changes.toVersion: OAuth 2.0 (modern authentication) or Microsoft Graph API

report.summary: Read only the CA/B SC-081 ballot page, the Exchange basic auth page and the Exchange SMTP AUTH timeline blog. The SC-081 page gives only the overall range, not per-step dates, so there is one change for the whole range. I did not read the Baseline Requirements, the Let's Encrypt feed, Chrome root policy, RFC 8996 or the other pages, because of budget. TLS 1.0/1.1 and Kubernetes, serverless, mobile and browser pages were left out as not relevant.
